entities.name: PMID:28648806
observations: CONVERT phase III randomized trial compared once-daily 66 Gy in 33 fractions with twice-daily 45 Gy in 30 fractions concurrent chemoradiotherapy for limited-stage small-cell lung cancer.
The reported grade ≥3 esophagitis rates were approximately 20% in each treatment arm, corresponding to answer choice H.

entities.name: CONVERT esophagitis
observations: Grade 3 or higher esophagitis occurred at similar rates in the once-daily and twice-daily radiotherapy arms, approximately 20% in each arm.
